summary: Auth feature testing completed. All 8 test scenarios verified: Dashboard 'Giriş Yap' button navigates to /auth, register/login API endpoints work correctly (11/11 backend tests passed), auth page UI has all required elements (tabs, Google button, all form fields, KVKK checkbox), KVKK frontend validation works, user name shown on dashboard after login, logout button works and returns to dashboard with Turkish toast. Full E2E flow tested.

design_issues.screen: Dashboard module icons vs feature cards
issues: Minor text inconsistency: Module icon row shows 'Mega Proje Haritası' (singular), but the feature card shows 'Mega Projeler Haritası' (plural). Consider aligning them.

action_items: Optional: Align 'Mega Proje Haritası' vs 'Mega Projeler Haritası' naming inconsistency on dashboard module icon vs card
critical_code_review_comments: KVKK validation is frontend-only - backend accepts registration without KVKK consent. This is acceptable if KVKK is a UI/UX requirement but consider adding a flag to backend if audit trail is needed.
JWT_SECRET_KEY defaults to 'your-secret-key-change-in-production' if env var missing - ensure it's set in production.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test users during backend tests (TEST_newuser_*@test.com, TEST_nkvkk_*@test.com) and 1 during UI testing (testui_*@test.com) - these persist in DB
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth system fully tested and working. Registration (POST /api/auth/register) and login (POST /api/auth/user-login) return {user, session_token}. Frontend stores user in localStorage 'app_user' and 'app_session_token'. Dashboard reads app_user from localStorage on load to show user name. AuthCallback at /auth/callback handles Google OAuth. Test user testuser@test.com/Test1234! already exists. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_user.py covers all auth flows.

features_tested.auth_page_register_form: PASS - Ad Soyad, Telefon, E-posta, Şifre, KVKK checkbox, Google button, submit all visible
features_tested.kvkk_validation: PASS - Submitting without KVKK shows toast 'KVKK onayı zorunludur'
features_tested.email_login: PASS - testuser@test.com logs in, user name 'Test Kullanıcı' shown on dashboard
features_tested.new_user_registration: PASS - New user registers, name shown on dashboard immediately
features_tested.logout: PASS - Logout clears session, dashboard shows 'Giriş Yap' button again, toast 'Çıkış yapıldı'
features_tested.turkish_texts: PASS - Yatırım Simülatörü, Mega Proje Haritası, Eğitim Merkezi all present
features_tested.google_button: PASS - 'Google ile devam et' button visible on both login and register modes

rca_of_issues: No critical issues found. All auth flows working end-to-end.
